actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The repository is a suite of GPU-accelerated environments for robot learning and sim-to-real, built with MuJoCo MJX
The suite includes the classic control environments from dm_control
The dm_control suite is a re-implementation of the DeepMind Control Suite using MJX
acrobot-swingup is one of the implemented dm_control suite environments
The acrobot environment class is Balance, a subclass of mjx_env.MjxEnv
The acrobot default config sets ctrl_dt=0.01, sim_dt=0.01, episode_length=1000 and action_repeat=1
The environment reads the acrobot MJCF text, builds mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string with the suite assets and writes sim_dt to model.opt.timestep
The suite assets are all files of the xmls/common directory, read as bytes
The acrobot MJCF is a model named acrobot that includes the visual, skybox and materials files
The MJCF default sets joint damping to .05 and capsule geoms of mass 1
The MJCF sets timestep 0.01 s, iterations 2 and ls_iterations 4, with constraint and eulerdamp disabled
The model has a floor plane, a target site at z=4 and fixed and lookat cameras
The model has two hinge joints named shoulder and elbow, a capsule arm for each, and a tip site at the far end of the lower arm
The model has one motor actuator on the elbow joint with gear 2 and ctrlrange -1 to 1
The environment's reset draws every qpos value uniformly from -pi to pi
The environment steps through mjx_env.step with n_substeps and reports done when qpos or qvel contains NaN
The observation concatenates the orientation vector and the joint velocities
The orientation vector is the horizontal and vertical components of the two arm body z-axes
The reward is a tolerance of the tip-to-target distance with bounds 0 to target_radius
The reward margin is 0.0 for the sparse variant and 1.0 for the dense variant
The action size is the model's number of actuators nu
The package requires Python 3.11 or newer
The runtime dependencies include mujoco-mjx>=3.6.0 and mujoco>=3.6.0

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates a fixed model and control sequence deterministically, and the bridge reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData + mj_forward), so a run can repeat exactly on the same engine; no seed controls the reset. The upstream environment's reset draws a random qpos (acrobot.py:80-85); this driver serves the raw model and does not reproduce that draw.

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it reads the model file for the actuator control range and the joint dimensions but integrates a placeholder motion of the actuated joint, so trajectories, contacts, friction and actuator dynamics are not MuJoCo's
the stand-in loads no mesh or texture and resolves no contact, constraint or tendon; it does not apply the elbow motor's gear ratio (acrobot.xml:41) and only exposes its ctrl range
MuJoCo itself and the JAX/MJX environment were not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine or with the Balance environment

the upstream environment adds an observation, a tolerance reward and a NaN episode terminator (acrobot.py:104-148) and resets qpos from a random draw (acrobot.py:80-85); this driver exposes only the raw cap.world.step/reset contract and not those environment features
no physical acrobot is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
